map.排列数计算器求从 n 个元素取 r 个的排列数 P(n,r)，适合组合数学、排班: The permutation number calculator computes the number of ordered selections P(n,r) of r from n elements, suited to ordered-choice problems in combinatorics, scheduling and probability.
map.从 n 个元素取 r 个的排列数。: The number of ways to arrange r items taken from n elements.
map.计算考虑顺序的安排数，如密码、排队、赛程: Compute arrangements where order matters, such as passwords, queues and race schedules
map.给 n 个物品排前 k 个位置的方式数: The number of ways to assign the first k positions from n items
map.在概率里算有序样本空间大小: Compute the size of an ordered sample space in probability
map.：10 个人选前 3 个领奖座位，排列数 P(10,3)=10×9×8=720。: 10 people competing for the top 3 seats gives P(10,3) = 10x9x8 = 720. Any change in seat order counts as a different result.
map.：n 个物品全排列为 n!=n×(n-1)×…×1；3 本书排架上 = 3!=6: A full permutation of n items is n! = n x (n-1) x ... x 1; shelving 3 books gives 3! = 6 arrangements.
map.P(n,k)=n!/(n-k)!，即从 n 开始连乘 k 个数。例 P(10,3: P(n,k) = n!/(n-k)!, that is, multiplying k consecutive numbers starting from n. For example P(10,3) = 10!/7! = 10x9x8.
map.什么时候用全排列 n!？: When do you use the full permutation n!?
map.当 k=n（全部排完）时 P(n,n)=n!。只要所有物品都参与排序就用全排列。: When k = n (all of them arranged) P(n,n) = n!. Use the full permutation whenever every item takes part in the order.
